11. Disable GetThere Configuration
Procedure
Navigate to Setup and Maintenance.
Search for Manage Travel Partner Integrations.
Open GetThere configuration.
Locate the Username field in the middle section of the configuration page.
Enter a random value.
Locate the Connection Password field below the Username field.
Enter a random value.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right section.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
